messages:
maria: Kicking off a staggered release for the console schema + router header swap. Need quick OKs from runtime, api, router teams. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 45m. rollback rule: 0.5% 5xx spike over 10m or console errors > 1%

sam: runtime: quick question — are we changing KV eviction keys or just header parsing?

maria: just header parsing + a tiny console payload rename. no KV touches.

oliver: router: can we avoid global header strip? we should do header passthrough on canary. I'll add a route override for canary shards.

kai: api: FYI this touches the runtime routing header key we used for model selection. can we ensure fallback to old header when missing?

maria: yes, runtime will accept both header variants for the first 2 waves. will implement fallback.

jen: release notes draft: "Console schema v2: header-forwarding toggle; safer parsing; no data migration." i'll push to the release-notes repo after we lock the pin.

maria: deploybot, preflight results?

deploybot: preflight checks started for wave 'console-header-swap' (canary=5%).

deploybot: checks: infra-health ✓, canary-env-ready ✓, metrics-hook ✓, rollout-locks clear ✓

maria: tagging a short checklist: 1) router override applied for canary shards (oliver) 2) runtime fallback enabled (sam) 3) API header acceptance tested (kai) 4) console opt-in flag enabled (jen) 5) deploybot wave armed (me)

oliver: router override deployed to shard-a and shard-b. added header passthrough rule `X-Console-Header-Alt` for canary.

sam: runtime fallback pushed to staging, unit tests green. i'll push to prod cluster in 3m and keep tvl low.

kai: smoke test: GET /v1/model with alt header -> 200, selection matches old header. sending small traffic to canary.

maria: starting canary now. deploybot, start wave.
deploybot: wave started — console-header-swap — canary=5% — initiated by maria — ts=5912348155

jen: heads-up: I'll watch console error dashboard and post notes.

oliver: router metrics good so far. latency +0.6ms on canary. no abnormal routing errs.

sam: runtime kv miss rate unchanged. no 5xx from runtime.

kai: api 10m rolling: 5xx=0.12%, p50 latency unchanged. can keep moving to 25% in 15m unless anyone objects.

maria: thumbs up from me. next wave at +15m unless rollback triggers. remember rollback path: `deploybot rollback --wave=console-header-swap`

jen: adding a short rollback playbook to the release notes: if trigger, pin console to v1, remove header-alt route, disable runtime fallback after traffic drains.

sam: quick note — after rollback, we'll need to rotate the runtime toggle off to avoid stale acceptance. I'll prepare a small migration job if needed.

oliver: agreed. also tagging ops on-call in case of routing flaps: @ops-oncall

deploybot: scheduled step: increase to 25% at ts=5912348260 (15m). monitoring enabled: errors, 5xx_rate, cpu.

maria: thanks all. i'll post a follow-up when 25% completes. :thumbsup:
